title: Secants closing on the tangent
caption: Slide $P$ along the curve to move the tangent, or $Q$ to change the run $h$. The table's secants, over $h$, a tenth of it and a hundredth, close on the slope the red pen rings.

assumed: $a$ tuned from $0$ to $2.5$ in steps of $0.05$
$h$ tuned from $0.1$ to $1$ in steps of $0.05$
